svg.title: AGV U300 electrical overview schematic – power, 24 V, safety, CAN (example)
svg.text: AGV U300 – electrical overview: 48 V power, precharge, branches, 24 V, safety (STO) and CAN
Values from guide 11 §4.2, §11.7, §11.9, §14.9 (corrected: FC1 40 A, 10 mm², chopper 58 V, BMS node 20). Overview only – not a wiring diagram.
DC bus +48 V (10 mm² from the battery)
24 V bus (PELV, 0 V to chassis at one point)
branches 2–4 A: KF1 safety ctrl · KF2 nav PC 4 A · BG1/BG2 2 A each · W1 Wi-Fi · brakes 4 A · sensors · lights
enters on the battery side of FC1
(BMS can open charge path; QA3 only
closed while the AGV stands on XD10)
STO1 + STO2 (2 channels) to A1, A2, A3
CAN 500 kbit/s line, 120 Ω at both ends (60 Ω check)
CAN to BMS (node 20) – or a separate bus if not CANopen
• I_B ≤ I_n ≤ I_Z on every branch
• safety stop = KF1 → STO, never CAN
• 0 V return: each branch back to
